column1: # Durations between two date-times in time zones, as ECMA-262 Temporal's
# DifferenceZonedDateTime gives them, taken step by step from the specification
# is moved to the earlier's time zone, whole days are counted on that wall clock,
# and the seconds are the time that passes after them. V8's Temporal (Node 24.9)
# resolved the wall-clock times; its own until follows an older algorithm.
# Columns: the earlier's time zone and Unix time, the later's time zone and Unix
# time, days, seconds, and the specification's seconds where they differ.
# They differ in one case: the earlier moment is the second occurrence of a time
# the clocks repeat and no whole day is counted. The specification resolves the
# earlier's wall-clock time again, at its first occurrence, and so counts the
# repeated time twice. The seconds here are the time that passes.
# A sample of 324,207 pairs about 36 changes of clocks in 12 time zones, and in
# three that have none, every one of which Localize was checked against.
